Thank you so much for taking the time to share your review on TripAdvisor and for recommending us! We are thrilled to hear that you enjoyed our prompt service, reasonable pricing, and vibrant dining atmosphere at The Daun Restaurant.

While our dining room can get busy, our team works hard to ensure every guest receives fast, attentive service. As a proudly Singaporean-Muslim owned establishment, it is our daily mission to be the most trusted, welcoming, and high-quality destination for local families and international travelers seeking authentic halal food in Saigon.

We take immense pride in our uncompromisingly clean and health-conscious culinary standards. Our kitchen prepares every dish using strictly no MSG, minimal salt, and non-GMO ingredients. Furthermore, to guarantee the absolute highest standards of hygiene and safety, we prepare all of our meals, rich broths, and drinks using only pure mineral water. We maintain these rigorous standards because our owner and his family dine here every single day—ensuring that we serve your table the exact same clean, nutritious, and premium meals we feed our own family.

Whether you are dropping by for a quick lunch or searching online for a top-rated, certified halal restaurant in Ho Chi Minh City, Vietnam, we look forward to welcoming you back to our family table on your next visit!

First Ho Chi Minh trip and lunching at Halal restaurant
Dec 2025 • Family
The food tasted delicious, better than some others halal around that area. Mee goreng is nice and savoury.. laksa yumsss.. the only thing I think lack of some spices is the nasi goreng kampung .. can improve on that.. the beverages are nice too. This halal restaurant has some Malaysian vibes and price wise to me is ok. But the only thing is the restaurant is small and cannot accommodate to very huge group. I think we are lucky as our family of 8 managed to dine here about noon time and after which the patrons to the restaurant were told the restaurant was full and couldn’t accom anymore diners… hope they can expand further …
